# DIS regression vectors

Raw DIS PDUs back to back (no UDP/IP framing), read by `parse <file>` and by
the tests in `src/dis/recordings.rs`. Copied, not referenced: these are
moving-map's test inputs and must not change when Sensors re-records
(Bobby, 2026-11-10).

| File | PDUs | Entity State | Remove Entity |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifecycle.bin` | 242 | 237 | 5 |
| `load-200.bin` | 3 220 | 3 020 | 200 |
| `ottawa-mixed.bin` | 554 | 541 | 13 |
| `zone-crossing.bin` | 546 | 541 | 5 |

**Provenance:** generated by Sensors `cgf.runner --record-raw`
(`github.com/bobbyc-brs/sensor_simulation`, commit `0e3c036`, country 39),
copied 2026-11-10. Synthetic — not a real simulator capture. Scenario
definitions are Sensors' `scenarios/*.json`; pcap versions stay in Sensors'
`recordings/`.

To refresh: copy the new `.bin` files, update the counts above and in
`src/dis/recordings.rs`, and log it in `TESTLOG.md`.
